Each notification channel switches on and off in its row, and joining the fortress again works after you removed a member.

## 🎨 Design
- **Built on GlimStone 4.9.2,** each channel's on/off switch moves from its window into its row, next to Send a test, Edit and Remove, and flipping it saves right away. A test shows how it went on its button and in the channel's line, and a channel without an address says so.
- **A switch the service refuses opens the channel's form** with the reason, so you can fix the channel there.
- **A time field you reach with Tab shows it with a step in its fill** instead of a ring, like the other fields.

## ⚡ Improved
- **ParleyPort 1.3.8.** The fortress and notification parts come from ParleyPort now. Your fortress membership, channels and settings carry over as they are.
- **Send a test also works on a channel that is switched off.**

## 🐛 Fixed
- **Joining the fortress again with the same words works after you removed a member.** TollRoll started that join without what it knew of the other members, so a removal that reached one of them a moment later could make both sides turn each other away.
- **The tile no longer shows an app as away right after it reconnects or gets a new name.** TollRoll keeps asking for a few seconds while it comes back, and shows a renamed app at once.
- **The time field no longer wears Unraid's orange button frame** on a server without the theme plugin.
- **A channel you remove comes back when the save fails.** It vanished from the page although nothing was saved.

## 🌐 Translations
- **No address yet and Switched off in all 26 languages.**
